posts.quoted: 【博客】我们发布了 PlaMo 3 Translate 的模型权重文件。该语言模型专用于翻译任务，提供 4 种配置：0.8B、2B、8B、31B 规模，所有配置都具备世界级的翻译能力。您可以下载这些模型并在本地进行测试。技术博客详细介绍了该模型的开发过程。

posts.author: sizumita
posts.name: すみどら
posts.text:
I also made an even smaller model for PLaMo 3 Translate!
With mixed_3_4, the weights went from 501MB → 423MB, and decode speed went from 334 → 352 tok/s, yet performance barely changed!

posts.quoted: Face swap using SS_FaceSwap_MiniMax_H3_REF2VA for MiniMax H3 in P-H3-Image’s Edit. Seems to be working well. The downside is that the face occasionally gets a bit too big. Adding expressions, angles, etc. to the prompt makes it better. The prompt is in the comments.
